Potential for addiction
A few years ago a couple friends of mine began experimenting with hydrocodone (mainly vicodin and a few others). I swore I would never try it because its related to heroin and thats for junkies. Well things have changed. A few months ago a new friend of mine, a former heroin addict, introduced me to the wonderful pleasures of prescription drugs. I tried vicodin a couple of time over the past few months but recently experimented with oxycodone (much more intense amazing euphoria). Since then I have been taking hydrocodone 10mg w/ 325mg of acetaminophen on weekends and occasionally a weeknight. Then I started taking them in the morning and at night. I'm actually pretty fucked up right now as I type this. The potential for addiction is amazing considering the feelings I experience are incredible and the dosage required increases greatly as a tolerance is built. I'm starting to wonder if deciding to sell hydrocodone was a good idea. I think I'm starting to love it and with a few hundred pills at my disposal....
